text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon never showed up, and training time passed right by.
...It's probably best to head home for today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good, good. Now to cross this drug under testing
with that other experiment—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oho! In that case, I can verify that other research at the same time... Yes, while I'm at it, that too...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Geez! Trainer! Why didn't you come pick me up?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, it's already nightfall!
I had all sorts of experiments I wanted to do today—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-What's with that look on your face?

She seemed so absorbed in getting ready that she lost track of time.
When I cautioned her, she pouted a bit,
but seemed to reflect on it reasonably well.
